description: Proves the drafted recipe through the remote browser pod's own TEE (/reclaim/prove) instead of the local attestor SDK. Use it instead of `run_proof` when the attach mode is "builder": the proof then reaches the target from the browser's own exit IP and country. Needs no `ownerAddress`; the pod signs with its own TEE key. It matches the browser's exit IP and country, not necessarily its TLS fingerprint, so it is not a way past bot protection: if `run_proof` reported `blocked-non-browser-client`, expect the same here.
name: run_proof_via_pod
